q: यांग शुआंग-ज़ी (Yáng Shuāng-zǐ) के किस उपन्यास ने प्रतिष्ठित अंतर्राष्ट्रीय बुकर पुरस्कार 2026 जीता?
e: *Taiwan Travelogue*, written by Taiwanese author Yáng Shuāng-zǐ (translated into English), won the International Booker Prize 2026. (ताइवानी लेखिका यांग शुआंग-ज़ी के उपन्यास 'ताइवान ट्रैवलॉग' ने अंतर्राष्ट्रीय बुकर पुरस्कार 2026 जीता।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) The International Booker Prize awards £50,000 split equally between the author and the translator for fiction translated into English; (2) Geetanjali Shree's Hindi novel *Ret Samadhi* (*Tomb of Sand*, translated by Daisy Rockwell) won the International Booker Prize in 2022; (3) Banu Mushtaq's Kannada collection *Heart Lamp* won in 2025; (4) The 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature was awarded to Anne Carson (Canada).
qe: Which novel by Yáng Shuāng-zǐ won the prestigious International Booker Prize 2026?

q:
सूची-I (पद्म भूषण 2026 विजेता) को सूची-II (क्षेत्र / विशिष्टता) से सुमेलित कीजिए और सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I: (1) अलका याग्निक, (2) ममूटी, (3) उदय कोटक, (4) शिबू सोरेन
सूची-II: (a) व्यापार एवं उद्योग, (b) लोक कार्य (मरणोपरांत), (c) कला (पार्श्वगायन), (d) कला (सिनेमा)
e: Padma Bhushan 2026 recipients include Alka Yagnik in Art/Playback Singing (1-c), Mammootty in Art/Cinema (2-d), Uday Kotak in Trade & Industry (3-a), and Shibu Soren in Public Affairs, Posthumous (4-b). (पद्म भूषण 2026 विजेता: अलका याग्निक-कला, ममूटी-कला, उदय कोटक-व्यापार एवं उद्योग, शिबू सोरेन-लोक कार्य मरणोपरांत; अतः 1-c, 2-d, 3-a, 4-b।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Padma Awards (Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri) were instituted in 1954 and are announced annually on the eve of Republic Day (26 January); (2) Padma Bhushan is India's third-highest civilian honour after Bharat Ratna and Padma Vibhushan; (3) Article 18 of the Constitution permits national awards like Bharat Ratna/Padma Awards as honours, not hereditary titles (Balaji Raghavan Case, 1996); (4) Shibu Soren served as Chief Minister of Jharkhand and founder of JMM.
qe:
Match List-I (Padma Bhushan 2026 Awardee) with List-II (Field / Distinction) and select the correct code:
List-I: (1) Alka Yagnik, (2) Mammootty, (3) Uday Kotak, (4) Shibu Soren
List-II: (a) Trade & Industry, (b) Public Affairs (Posthumous), (c) Art (Playback Singing), (d) Art (Cinema)

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल ने किस प्रमुख सामाजिक कल्याण योजना के लिए ₹53,428 करोड़ के कुल वित्तीय परिव्यय को मंजूरी दी?
e: In October 2026, the Union Cabinet approved ₹53,428 crore for the Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana to strengthen social security pensions and direct assistance for vulnerable citizens. (अक्टूबर 2026 में केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल ने प्रधानमंत्री सामाजिक सहायता योजना के लिए ₹53,428 करोड़ के परिव्यय को मंजूरी दी।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Social assistance schemes derive constitutional backing from Article 41 (DPSP — right to public assistance in old age, sickness, and disablement); (2) Earlier, the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) was launched on 15 August 1995; (3) NSAP components include Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension, Widow Pension, and Disability Pension Schemes; (4) Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) ensures leak-proof delivery into Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.
qe: In October 2026, the Union Cabinet approved a total financial outlay of ₹53,428 crore for which flagship social welfare initiative?
oe: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में भारत सरकार ने 'SIOFA' में भारत के सम्मिलित होने (accession) को मंजूरी दी। SIOFA का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
o: Sustainable Indian Ocean Maritime Framework Accord
e: SIOFA stands for the Southern Indian Ocean Fisheries Agreement, a regional fisheries management agreement aimed at long-term conservation and sustainable use of deep-sea fishery resources in the Southern Indian Ocean high seas. (SIOFA का पूर्ण रूप 'सदर्न इंडियन ओशन फिशरीज़ एग्रीमेंट' है, जिसका उद्देश्य दक्षिणी हिंद महासागर में मत्स्य संसाधनों का सतत संरक्षण है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) SIOFA entered into force in 2012 with its secretariat based in Réunion Island; (2) India's accession enhances its blue-economy footprint and responsible high-seas fishing rights; (3) India is also a member of the Indian Ocean Tuna Commission (IOTC) and Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA); (4) India's 'Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana' (PMMSY, 2020) drives domestic fisheries growth.
qe: In October 2026, the Government of India approved India's accession to 'SIOFA'. What does SIOFA stand for?
oe: Sustainable Indian Ocean Maritime Framework Accord

q:
अक्टूबर 2026 में भारतीय नौसेना की उपलब्धियों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: स्वदेशी फ्लीट सपोर्ट शिप 'सूर्या' का विशाखापत्तनम में जलावतरण किया गया।
कथन II: स्वदेशी युद्धपोत 'मांगरोल' को भारतीय नौसेना में शामिल (कमीशन) किया गया।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: न तो कथन I और न ही कथन II
कथन I और कथन II दोनों
e: Both statements are correct. In October 2026, Hindustan Shipyard Limited (Visakhapatnam) launched the indigenous Fleet Support Ship 'Surya', and the Indian Navy commissioned warship 'Mangrol', advancing maritime Aatmanirbharta. (दोनों कथन सही हैं; अक्टूबर 2026 में विशाखापत्तनम में फ्लीट सपोर्ट शिप 'सूर्या' का जलावतरण हुआ और युद्धपोत 'मांगरोल' नौसेना में कमीशन किया गया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Visakhapatnam is the headquarters of the Eastern Naval Command of the Indian Navy; (2) Fleet Support Ships replenish warships at sea with fuel, water, ammunition, and stores; (3) Navy Day in India is celebrated every year on 4 December (commemorating Operation Trident, 1971); (4) INS Vikrant (commissioned Sept 2022) is India's first indigenous aircraft carrier.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding Indian Navy milestones achieved in October 2026:
Statement I: The indigenous Fleet Support Ship 'Surya' was launched in Visakhapatnam.
Statement II: The indigenous naval warship 'Mangrol' was commissioned into the Indian Navy.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Neither Statement I nor Statement II
Both Statement I and Statement II

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में किस पूर्वोत्तर राज्य ने बहुभाषी कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI) विकास के लिए 'भाषिणी' (BHASHINI) के साथ समझौता किया?
e: In October 2026, Manipur signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the National Language Translation Mission's 'BHASHINI' platform to build multilingual AI tools and voice-enabled public services in local languages. (अक्टूबर 2026 में मणिपुर ने स्थानीय भाषाओं में बहुभाषी AI विकास हेतु 'भाषिणी' के साथ समझौता किया।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) BHASHINI stands for 'BHASHa INterface for India', launched by the Ministry of Electronics and IT (MeitY) under Digital India; (2) Manipuri (Meitei) is included in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution (added by the 71st Amendment Act, 1992 along with Konkani and Nepali); (3) Loktak Lake (with Keibul Lamjao, the world's only floating National Park) is in Manipur; (4) The Eighth Schedule currently recognizes 22 official languages.
qe: In October 2026, which Northeastern state signed an agreement with 'BHASHINI' for multilingual Artificial Intelligence (AI) development?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश हिंदी संस्थान और उत्तर प्रदेश संगीत नाटक अकादमी का मुख्यालय किस शहर में स्थित है?
e: Both the Uttar Pradesh Hindi Sansthan (established 30 December 1976) and the UP Sangeet Natak Akademi (established 1963) are headquartered in Lucknow. (उत्तर प्रदेश हिंदी संस्थान (1976) एवं उत्तर प्रदेश संगीत नाटक अकादमी (1963) दोनों का मुख्यालय लखनऊ में स्थित है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) UP Hindi Sansthan awards the prestigious 'Bharat Bharati Samman' (highest literary award of UP); (2) Hindustani Academy (established 1927) is headquartered in Prayagraj; (3) Nagari Pracharini Sabha (1893) is located in Varanasi; (4) Bharat Kala Bhavan museum is situated inside BHU, Varanasi.
qe: Which city of Uttar Pradesh is home to the headquarters of the Uttar Pradesh Hindi Sansthan and the Uttar Pradesh Sangeet Natak Akademi?

q:
सूची-I (उ.प्र. के प्रमुख शोध संस्थान) को सूची-II (स्थान) से सुमेलित कीजिए और सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I: (1) भारतीय दलहन अनुसंधान संस्थान, (2) केंद्रीय औषधि अनुसंधान संस्थान, (3) भारतीय पशु चिकित्सा अनुसंधान संस्थान, (4) भारतीय सब्जी अनुसंधान संस्थान
सूची-II: (a) इज्जतनगर (बरेली), (b) वाराणसी, (c) कानपुर, (d) लखनऊ
e: Indian Institute of Pulses Research — Kanpur (1-c); Central Drug Research Institute (CDRI) — Lucknow (2-d); Indian Veterinary Research Institute (IVRI) — Izatnagar, Bareilly (3-a); Indian Institute of Vegetable Research (IIVR) — Varanasi (4-b). (दलहन-कानपुर, औषधि-लखनऊ, पशु चिकित्सा-इज्जतनगर बरेली, सब्जी-वाराणसी; अतः 1-c, 2-d, 3-a, 4-b।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) National Sugar Institute is in Kanpur, whereas Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research is in Lucknow; (2) National Botanical Research Institute (NBRI) and Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture are in Lucknow; (3) Central Potato Research Station campus in UP is at Modipuram (Meerut); (4) Central Glass and Ceramic Research Institute (UP centre) is at Khurja (Bulandshahr).
qe:
Match List-I (Major Research Institute in UP) with List-II (Location) and choose the correct code:
List-I: (1) Indian Institute of Pulses Research, (2) Central Drug Research Institute, (3) Indian Veterinary Research Institute, (4) Indian Institute of Vegetable Research
List-II: (a) Izatnagar (Bareilly), (b) Varanasi, (c) Kanpur, (d) Lucknow

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा जिला भारत के सर्वाधिक चार राज्यों (मध्य प्रदेश, छत्तीसगढ़, झारखंड और बिहार) की सीमाओं को स्पर्श करता है?
e: Sonbhadra is the only district in India that touches the borders of four states: Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and Bihar. (सोनभद्र देश का एकमात्र जिला है जो चार राज्यों—म.प्र., छत्तीसगढ़, झारखंड व बिहार—की सीमाओं को स्पर्श करता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Saharanpur touches 3 states: Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and Haryana; (2) Lalitpur is surrounded on three sides by Madhya Pradesh; (3) Ballia is the easternmost district of UP, Shamli the westernmost, Saharanpur the northernmost, and Sonbhadra the southernmost; (4) UP shares its border with 8 states + 1 UT (Delhi) and 1 international border (Nepal — 7 UP districts).
qe: Which district of Uttar Pradesh shares its borders with the maximum number of Indian states (four states: Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and Bihar)?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के प्रमुख मेलों और उनके आयोजन स्थलों का निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e: Dadri Mela (famous cattle fair where Bharatendu Harishchandra delivered his 1884 speech) is held in BALLIA district, NOT Gorakhpur. Gorakhpur hosts the famous Khichdi Mela (Makar Sankranti). (ददरी मेला बलिया जिले में आयोजित होता है, न कि गोरखपुर में; गोरखपुर में खिचड़ी मेला लगता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Bateshwar Mela (Agra) is a famous cattle/camel fair on the Yamuna banks; (2) Nauchandi Mela (Meerut) is held annually after Holi as a symbol of communal harmony; (3) Dewa Sharif Mela (Barabanki) honours Sufi saint Haji Waris Ali Shah; (4) Kampil Fair is held in Farrukhabad and Shakumbhari Devi Mela in Saharanpur.
qe: Which of the following fairs (Melas) of Uttar Pradesh and their venues is NOT correctly matched?

q: भारत की सबसे बड़ी कृत्रिम झील 'रिहंद बाँध' (गोविन्द बल्लभ पंत सागर) उत्तर प्रदेश के किस जिले में रिहंद नदी पर निर्मित है?
e: Rihand Dam (Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar) is constructed at Pipri in Sonbhadra district on the Rihand river, a tributary of the Son river. (रिहंद बाँध सोनभद्र जिले के पिपरी में सोन की सहायक रिहंद नदी पर स्थित है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Matatila Dam and Rajghat Dam are built on the Betwa river in Lalitpur/Jhansi; (2) Sharda Canal is the longest canal system in Uttar Pradesh; (3) Narora Atomic Power Station is situated in Bulandshahr district on the Ganga; (4) Obra and Anpara thermal power stations are located in Sonbhadra.
qe: The 'Rihand Dam' (Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar), India's largest artificial lake by volume, is built on the Rihand river in which district of Uttar Pradesh?

q: एकेश्वरवाद के प्रचार और सती प्रथा जैसी सामाजिक कुरीतियों के उन्मूलन हेतु 1828 ई. में कलकत्ता में 'ब्रह्म समाज' की स्थापना किसने की थी?
e: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded the Brahmo Sabha (later Brahmo Samaj) on 20 August 1828 in Calcutta; his relentless campaign led Lord William Bentinck to abolish Sati via Regulation XVII of 1829. (राजा राममोहन राय ने 1828 में ब्रह्म समाज की स्थापना की तथा उनके प्रयासों से 1829 में सती प्रथा समाप्त हुई।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Earlier he founded Atmiya Sabha (1815) and published 'Samvad Kaumudi' (Bengali) and 'Mirat-ul-Akhbar' (Persian); (2) Swami Dayananda Saraswati founded Arya Samaj in 1875 (Bombay) and wrote 'Satyarth Prakash'; (3) Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar championed the Hindu Widows' Remarriage Act, 1856; (4) Swami Vivekananda founded the Ramakrishna Mission in 1897.
qe: Who founded the 'Brahmo Samaj' in Calcutta in 1828 to promote monotheism and abolish social evils like Sati?

q: महात्मा गांधी ने बंबई के ग्वालिया टैंक मैदान से "करो या मरो" के नारे के साथ 'भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन' किस वर्ष प्रारंभ किया?
e: The All India Congress Committee passed the Quit India Resolution on 8 August 1942 at Gowalia Tank Maidan (August Kranti Maidan), Bombay, launching the movement on 9 August 1942. (8 अगस्त 1942 को बंबई में भारत छोड़ो प्रस्ताव पारित हुआ और 9 अगस्त 1942 से आंदोलन प्रारंभ हुआ।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Aruna Asaf Ali hoisted the tricolour at Gowalia Tank Maidan during the movement; (2) Parallel governments (Prati Sarkars) were set up in Ballia (UP, under Chittu Pandey), Tamluk (Bengal), and Satara (Maharashtra); (3) Cripps Mission (March 1942) failure immediately preceded the movement; (4) Usha Mehta operated the secret Congress Radio in Bombay during Quit India.
qe: In which year did Mahatma Gandhi launch the 'Quit India Movement' (भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन) from Gowalia Tank Maidan in Bombay with the slogan "Do or Die"?

q: संगम युग के प्रसिद्ध तमिल महाकाव्य 'शिलप्पादिकारम्' के रचयिता कौन थे?
e: 'Silappadikaram' (The Tale of an Anklet — story of Kovalan, Kannagi, and Madhavi) was composed by Chera prince-monk Ilango Adigal. (संगम साहित्य के महाकाव्य 'शिलप्पादिकारम्' के रचयिता इलंगो अडिगल थे।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) 'Manimekalai' (sequel to Silappadikaram) was written by Sittalai Sattanar; (2) 'Tirukkural' (the 'Bible of Tamil Land') was authored by Tiruvalluvar; (3) 'Tolkappiyam' (oldest extant Tamil grammar text) was written by Tolkappiyar; (4) The three Sangams were patronized by the Pandya kings at Madurai and Kapatapuram.
qe: Who was the author of the famous Tamil epic 'Silappadikaram' (शिलप्पादिकारम्) of the Sangam Age?

q:
सम्राट अशोक के अभिलेखों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: जेम्स प्रिंसेप ने 1837 में सर्वप्रथम अशोक के अभिलेखों की ब्राह्मी लिपि को पढ़ा था।
कथन II: अशोक का व्यक्तिगत नाम 'अशोक' स्पष्ट रूप से मास्की, गुर्जरा, नेट्टूर और उदेगोलम के लघु शिलालेखों में मिलता है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: कथन I और कथन II दोनों
न तो कथन I और न ही कथन II
e: Both statements are completely correct. James Prinsep deciphered Brahmi in 1837, and while most edicts use 'Devanampiya Piyadasi', four minor rock edicts (Maski, Gujarra, Nettur, Udegolam) explicitly mention his name 'Ashoka'. (दोनों कथन सत्य हैं; 1837 में जेम्स प्रिंसेप ने ब्राह्मी लिपि पढ़ी तथा मास्की, गुर्जरा, नेट्टूर व उदेगोलम अभिलेखों में 'अशोक' नाम मिलता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Major Rock Edict XIII describes the Kalinga War (261 BCE) and Ashoka's turn to Dhamma; (2) Ashokan inscriptions use 4 scripts: Brahmi (most of India), Kharosthi (NW Pakistan — Shahbazgarhi & Mansehra), Greek, and Aramaic (Afghanistan); (3) Sarnath Lion Capital (Varanasi, UP) is India's National Emblem; (4) Kalsi (Uttarakhand) and Kaushambi/Prayagraj Pillar are famous nearby edicts.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding Emperor Ashoka's inscriptions:
Statement I: James Prinsep first deciphered the Brahmi script of Ashokan inscriptions in 1837.
Statement II: Ashoka's personal name 'Ashoka' explicitly appears in the Maski, Gujarra, Nettur, and Udegolam minor rock edicts.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: किस मुगल सम्राट ने 1575 ई. में फतेहपुर सीकरी में 'इबादतखाना' की स्थापना की और 'सुलह-ए-कुल' (सार्वभौमिक शांति) की नीति अपनाई?
e: Akbar built the Ibadat Khana at Fatehpur Sikri in 1575 for religious discussions (opened to all faiths in 1578), issued the Mahzar Nama (1579), and promoted Din-i-Ilahi (1582) and Sulh-i-Kul. (अकबर ने 1575 में फतेहपुर सीकरी में इबादतखाना बनवाया और सुलह-ए-कुल की नीति अपनाई।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Akbar abolished Jizya in 1564 and Pilgrimage Tax in 1563; (2) He introduced the Mansabdari system and Todar Mal's Dahsala land revenue system (1580); (3) Buland Darwaza at Fatehpur Sikri commemorates Akbar's Gujarat victory; (4) Abul Fazl authored 'Akbarnama' and 'Ain-i-Akbari'.
qe: Which of the following Mughal emperors established the 'Ibadat Khana' (1575) at Fatehpur Sikri and promulgated 'Sulh-i-Kul' (Universal Peace)?

q: भारतीय संविधान के किस भाग में राज्य के नीति निदेशक तत्व (अनुच्छेद 36 से 51) निहित हैं?
e: Part IV (Articles 36–51) contains the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP), borrowed from the Constitution of Ireland. (भाग IV (अनुच्छेद 36–51) में राज्य के नीति निदेशक तत्व हैं, जिन्हें आयरलैंड के संविधान से लिया गया है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Part III (Articles 12–35) covers Fundamental Rights (borrowed from USA); (2) Part IVA (Article 51A) covers Fundamental Duties (42nd Amendment, 1976); (3) DPSPs are non-justiciable in courts (Article 37), yet fundamental in governance; (4) Article 45 (ECCE) and Article 46 (SC/ST educational interests) are key educational DPSPs.
qe: Which Part of the Indian Constitution contains the Directive Principles of State Policy (Articles 36 to 51)?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अंतर्गत संसद के किसी भी सदन को आहूत करने, सत्रावसान करने और लोकसभा को विघटित करने की शक्ति किसके पास है?
e: Under Article 85(2), the President of India summons and prorogues either House of Parliament and dissolves the Lok Sabha (on the aid and advice of the Council of Ministers under Article 74). (अनुच्छेद 85 के अंतर्गत राष्ट्रपति संसद सत्र आहूत व सत्रावसान करते हैं तथा लोकसभा भंग करते हैं।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Adjournment (स्थगन) of a sitting is done by the Presiding Officer (Speaker/Chairman), NOT the President; (2) Joint sitting of both Houses (Article 108) is summoned by the President and presided over by the Speaker of Lok Sabha; (3) Rajya Sabha is a permanent House (Article 83) and cannot be dissolved (1/3rd members retire every 2 years); (4) Minimum age: Lok Sabha 25 yrs, Rajya Sabha 30 yrs, President/Governor 35 yrs.
qe: Under the Indian Constitution, who has the power to summon and prorogue either House of Parliament and dissolve the Lok Sabha?

q: किस संविधान संशोधन द्वारा भारत में मतदान की न्यूनतम आयु 21 वर्ष से घटाकर 18 वर्ष (अनुच्छेद 326 में संशोधन) की गई?
e: The 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988 (effective 28 March 1989) amended Article 326 to lower the voting age for Lok Sabha and State Assembly elections from 21 to 18 years. (61वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 1988 द्वारा अनुच्छेद 326 में संशोधन कर मतदान आयु 21 से 18 वर्ष की गई।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) National Voters' Day is celebrated on 25 January (Election Commission foundation day: 25 January 1950); (2) 44th Amendment (1978) moved Right to Property from Fundamental Right to Legal Right (Article 300A); (3) 69th Amendment (1991) gave Delhi the special status of National Capital Territory (NCT); (4) 86th Amendment (2002) added Article 21A (Right to Education).
qe: Which Constitutional Amendment lowered the voting age in India from 21 years to 18 years (amending Article 326)?

q: निःशुल्क और अनिवार्य बाल शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) अधिनियम, 2009 की धारा 13 के अंतर्गत प्रवेश के समय कैपिटेशन शुल्क (capitation fee) वसूलने वाले विद्यालय पर अधिकतम कितना जुर्माना लगाया जा सकता है?
o: वसूले गए कैपिटेशन शुल्क का पाँच गुना
वसूले गए कैपिटेशन शुल्क का दस गुना
e: Under Section 13(2)(a) of the RTE Act, 2009, any school or person receiving a capitation fee is punishable with a fine extending up to TEN TIMES the capitation fee charged. (RTE अधिनियम की धारा 13(2)(a) के अंतर्गत कैपिटेशन शुल्क लेने पर वसूले गए शुल्क का दस गुना तक जुर्माना निर्धारित है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Under Section 13(2)(b), subjecting a child to a screening procedure attracts a fine up to ₹25,000 for the first contravention and ₹50,000 for each subsequent contravention; (2) Section 18 mandates a Certificate of Recognition for running a school (unrecognized school faces fine up to ₹1 lakh + ₹10,000/day); (3) Section 17 bans corporal punishment and mental harassment; (4) Section 28 bans private tuition by teachers.
qe: Under the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009, what is the maximum permissible penalty (fine) on a school that collects capitation fee during admission (Section 13)?
oe: Five times the capitation fee charged
Ten times the capitation fee charged

q:
92वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 2003 द्वारा निम्नलिखित में से किन भाषाओं को भारतीय संविधान की आठवीं अनुसूची में जोड़ा गया?
1. बोडो  2. डोगरी  3. मैथिली  4. संथाली
e: All four languages—Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, and Santhali (remembered as 'BDMS')—were added to the Eighth Schedule by the 92nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2003, raising the total from 18 to 22 languages. (92वें संशोधन (2003) द्वारा बोडो, डोगरी, मैथिली और संथाली चारों भाषाएँ आठवीं अनुसूची में जोड़ी गईं।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Originally the Constitution had 14 languages in the Eighth Schedule; (2) 21st Amendment (1967) added Sindhi (15th); (3) 71st Amendment (1992) added Konkani, Manipuri, and Nepali (16th–18th); (4) Article 343–351 (Part XVII) deal with Official Language provisions.
qe:
Which of the following languages was added to the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution by the 92nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2003?
1. Bodo  2. Dogri  3. Maithili  4. Santhali

q: भारत के निर्विवाद क्षेत्र (उत्तराखंड) में पूर्णतः स्थित सबसे ऊँची पर्वत चोटी कौन-सी है?
e: Nanda Devi (7,816 m) in Chamoli district, Uttarakhand is the highest peak lying entirely within undisputed Indian territory (Kanchenjunga, 8,586 m, lies on the India–Nepal border; K2 lies in PoK). (उत्तराखंड स्थित नंदा देवी (7,816 मी) पूर्णतः भारत के भीतर स्थित सर्वोच्च चोटी है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Kanchenjunga (Sikkim–Nepal border) is the highest peak in India under Indian administration (3rd highest in the world); (2) Anamudi (2,695 m, Kerala) is the highest peak of the Western Ghats and South India; (3) Guru Shikhar (1,722 m, Mt. Abu) is the highest peak of the Aravalli Range; (4) Dhupgarh (1,350 m) is the highest peak of the Satpura Range.
qe: Which is the highest mountain peak located entirely within the undisputed territory of India (in Uttarakhand)?

q: भारत की कौन-सी दो प्रमुख प्रायद्वीपीय नदियाँ भ्रंश घाटियों (rift valleys) से होकर पश्चिम की ओर बहती हैं और डेल्टा बनाए बिना अरब सागर में गिरती हैं?
e: The Narmada (origin: Amarkantak, MP) and Tapi/Tapti (origin: Multai, Betul, MP) flow westwards through structural rift valleys between Vindhya–Satpura–Ajanta ranges and form estuaries (not deltas) in the Arabian Sea. (नर्मदा और तापी भ्रंश घाटियों से पश्चिम की ओर बहकर अरब सागर में ज्वारनदमुख (estuary) बनाती हैं।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Godavari ('Dakshin Ganga' / 'Vridha Ganga') is the longest peninsular river (1,465 km); (2) Sardar Sarovar Dam (Gujarat) and Dhuandhar Falls (Jabalpur) are on the Narmada; (3) Ukai Dam (Gujarat) is on the Tapi river; (4) Damodar river also flows through a rift valley (eastwards) in the Chota Nagpur Plateau.
qe: Which two major peninsular rivers of India flow WESTWARDS through rift valleys and drain into the Arabian Sea without forming deltas?

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार भारत के सभी राज्यों में किस राज्य का लिंगानुपात (प्रति 1,000 पुरुषों पर महिलाएँ) न्यूनतम था?
e: Per Census 2011, Haryana recorded the lowest sex ratio among Indian states at 879 females per 1,000 males (national average: 943; UP: 912; highest state: Kerala at 1,084). (जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार राज्यों में न्यूनतम लिंगानुपात हरियाणा (879) का था, जबकि भारत का औसत 943 तथा उ.प्र. का 912 था।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Among Union Territories, Daman & Diu had the lowest sex ratio (618) and Puducherry the highest (1,037); (2) In Uttar Pradesh, Jaunpur recorded the highest sex ratio (1,024) and Gautam Buddha Nagar the lowest (851); (3) India's Child Sex Ratio (0–6 yrs) in Census 2011 was 919 (UP: 902); (4) India's overall literacy rate in 2011 was 74.04% (UP: 67.68%).
qe: According to Census 2011, which state of India had the LOWEST sex ratio (females per 1,000 males) among all Indian states?

q: 12 जुलाई 1982 को स्थापित कौन-सी संस्था भारत में कृषि एवं ग्रामीण विकास पुनर्वित्तपोषण का शीर्ष बैंक है?
e: NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) was established on 12 July 1982 on the recommendation of the B. Sivaraman Committee (headquarters: Mumbai). (नाबार्ड की स्थापना 12 जुलाई 1982 को बी. शिवरामन समिति की सिफारिश पर हुई; इसका मुख्यालय मुंबई में है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) SIDBI (Small Industries Development Bank of India) was established in 1990 with headquarters in LUCKNOW (UP); (2) SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) became statutory in 1992 (headquarters: Mumbai); (3) RBI was established on 1 April 1935 (Hilton Young Commission) and nationalized on 1 January 1949; (4) Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) were first established on 2 October 1975 (Prathama Bank, Moradabad, UP).
qe: Which institution is the apex bank for agricultural and rural development refinancing in India, established on 12 July 1982?

q: भारत में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कर एक प्रत्यक्ष कर (DIRECT tax) है, जिसका कराघात और करापात एक ही व्यक्ति पर पड़ता है?
e: Corporation Tax (levied on net profits of companies) and Personal Income Tax are Direct Taxes, whereas GST, Customs Duty, and Excise Duty are Indirect Taxes. (निगम कर और आयकर प्रत्यक्ष कर हैं, जबकि GST, सीमा शुल्क और उत्पाद शुल्क अप्रत्यक्ष कर हैं।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) administers direct taxes, while CBIC administers indirect taxes (GST & Customs); (2) GST was implemented across India on 1 July 2017 ('One Nation, One Tax'); (3) Progressive taxation means the tax rate increases as taxable income increases; (4) Fiscal Deficit = Total Expenditure − Total Receipts (excluding borrowings).
qe: Which tax in India is a DIRECT tax (whose impact and incidence fall on the same person)?

q: अर्थशास्त्र में 'स्टैगफ्लेशन' (Stagflation) उस असामान्य समष्टि आर्थिक स्थिति को दर्शाता है जिसमें एक साथ विद्यमान रहते हैं:
o: उच्च आर्थिक वृद्धि तथा गिरती कीमतें
उच्च मुद्रास्फीति, स्थिर आर्थिक वृद्धि तथा उच्च बेरोजगारी
तीव्र अपस्फीति तथा बढ़ता औद्योगिक उत्पादन
e: Stagflation combines 'stagnation' (slow/stagnant GDP growth + high unemployment) with 'inflation' (persistently rising prices), defying the simple Phillips Curve trade-off. (स्टैगफ्लेशन में उच्च मुद्रास्फीति के साथ-साथ आर्थिक ठहराव और उच्च बेरोजगारी एक साथ मौजूद रहते हैं।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Deflation is a sustained fall in the general price level (negative inflation); (2) Disinflation is a slowdown in the rate of inflation (prices still rise, but more slowly); (3) Core Inflation excludes volatile food and fuel prices; (4) RBI targets CPI (Combined) retail inflation at 4% ± 2% (2% to 6% band).
qe: In economics, 'Stagflation' refers to an unusual macroeconomic situation characterized by the simultaneous occurrence of:
oe: High economic growth and falling prices
High inflation, stagnant economic growth, and high unemployment
Rapid deflation and rising industrial output

q: किस कोशिकांग को कोशिका का "पावरहाउस" (ऊर्जागृह) कहा जाता है क्योंकि यह कोशिकीय श्वसन द्वारा ATP उत्पन्न करता है?
e: Mitochondria synthesize Adenosine Triphosphate (ATP), the energy currency of the cell, via aerobic cellular respiration and also contain their own circular DNA. (माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया कोशिकीय श्वसन द्वारा ATP का निर्माण करते हैं, इसलिए इन्हें कोशिका का ऊर्जागृह कहा जाता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Lysosomes are called 'Suicidal Bags' of the cell due to hydrolytic digestive enzymes; (2) Ribosomes are the 'Protein Factories' of the cell; (3) Chloroplasts (plastids in plant cells) are the 'Kitchen of the Cell' where photosynthesis occurs; (4) Robert Hooke discovered cells in 1665 (in cork).
qe: Which cell organelle is known as the "Powerhouse of the Cell" because it generates ATP through cellular respiration?

q: किस नेत्र दोष में दूर की वस्तुओं का प्रतिबिंब रेटिना के आगे बनता है और इसे सुधारने के लिए अवतल (CONCAVE) लेंस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: In Myopia (near-sightedness), near objects are seen clearly but distant objects appear blurred because rays focus in front of the retina; a concave lens diverges rays to focus them on the retina. (निकटदृष्टि दोष (मायोपिया) में दूर की वस्तु का प्रतिबिंब रेटिना से पहले बनता है, जिसे अवतल लेंस से ठीक किया जाता है।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) Hypermetropia (far-sightedness) is corrected with a CONVEX lens; (2) Presbyopia (age-related loss of accommodation) is corrected with bifocal lenses; (3) Astigmatism is corrected with cylindrical lenses; (4) Power of a lens P (in dioptres) = 1 / f (in metres); concave lens has negative power.
qe: Which eye defect is corrected using a CONCAVE (diverging) lens because distant objects focus in front of the retina?

q: शैक्षिक प्रौद्योगिकी एवं साइबर सुरक्षा में 'फ़िशिंग' (Phishing) क्या है?
o: बड़े वीडियो व्याख्यानों को संपीड़ित करने की तकनीक
भ्रामक ईमेल या वेबसाइटों द्वारा संवेदनशील पासवर्ड व डेटा चुराने का कपटपूर्ण प्रयास
e: Phishing is a cyberattack in which attackers masquerade as trusted entities via fake emails, SMS (smishing), or spoofed websites to trick users into revealing passwords, OTPs, or banking details. (फ़िशिंग एक साइबर अपराध है जिसमें नकली ईमेल या वेबसाइट के माध्यम से उपयोगकर्ता के पासवर्ड, OTP आदि चुराए जाते हैं।) Exam Booster Facts: (1) CERT-In (Indian Computer Emergency Response Team) is India's nodal cybersecurity agency under MeitY; (2) Ransomware encrypts a victim's files and demands ransom for decryption; (3) Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) significantly protects accounts against phishing; (4) The National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal is cybercrime.gov.in (helpline 1930).
qe: In Educational Technology and cybersecurity, what is 'Phishing'?
oe: A technique to compress large video lectures
A fraudulent attempt using deceptive emails or websites to steal sensitive credentials
